# Slider

A range input with a visible label and value readout in mono.

`Headwaters.Slider` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<Headwaters.Slider label="…" min={0} max={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Headwaters.Slider" label="…" min="{{0}}" max="{{0}}"></x-import>
```
